name: Danganronpa: Dual Fates
source:
Ryosuke 'Ryo' Hira is invited to the octennial Ultimate Banquet - an event held at the start of the year to celebrate a class of Ultimates - talented youths who are skilled in various fields, destined to cultivate hope in their nation. 

However, things take a turn for the worst as the 19th Generation of Ultimates find themselves in an unfamiliar environment serving as the stage for an unfathomably tragic event.

The Despair-Class Confinement.

[From [url=https://team-dual-fates.itch.io/danganronpadf]itch.io[/url]]
